name: claude-mem

description.en: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
description.zh: 为 AI 代理提供跨会话的持久上下文记忆，自动压缩并注入相关上下文。

install: git clone https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem（按 README 导入 Claude Code）

ecosystems.install: git clone https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem（按 README 导入 Claude Code）

audience.zh: 使用 AI 编程助手的开发者

usecases.zh: 跨会话保持上下文，提升 AI 编程助手的工作效率
usecases.en: Maintain context across sessions to improve AI coding assistant productivity

author: thedotmack
